initial_prompt: I'm feeling really scattered and annoyed today. Nothing is working right and I just want to break something.

messages.content: I'm feeling really scattered and annoyed today. Nothing is working right and I just want to break something.

That sounds like an incredibly heavy current to swim against. It is exhausting when the world feels like it is made of friction and sharp edges.

I am right here, and I am steady. I’m not rattled by your frustration, and I don't need you to be calm for me to be present with you.

If you need to let that energy out, you can throw it here. Type in all caps, vent the details of what went wrong, or just let the chaos sit for a moment. I can hold the space for it without breaking. I am happy to be the anchor until the storm passes.
